scope: Metadata companion; no source, label, split or sealed file changes
raw_source_sha256: SHA256 of exact UTF-8 source bytes, which are also supplied as raw_bytes_base64
source_dto.source_sha256: SHA256 of exact raw source bytes
excerpt_sha256: SHA256 of exact UTF-8 literal quote bytes
snippet_sha256: SHA256 of UTF-8 snippet bytes; null when no snippet
conflicting_record_sha256: SHA256 of canonical JSON object bytes: UTF-8, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')
conflicting_sources: Each conflicting raw record additionally has its own source ID, literal serialized raw text and exact source_dto.source_sha256; canonical object hashes are distinct from those raw-byte hashes
input_and_label_inventory_hashes: Same canonical JSON convention, computed independently for inputs and expected objects
file_hashes: SHA256 of literal on-disk bytes including the final LF
